description: A BI-style top N and bottom N toolbar for the Svelte 5 data grid: pick a metric such as revenue, pick N, pick top or bottom, and the grid shows those rows while a KPI strip reports how much of the total the slice covers. It composes with the column-menu filters, so top 5 in EMEA works, and it is plain user-land code: sort a copy of the visible data and slice.

faq.question: How is top N implemented?
faq.answer: A $derived sorts a copy of the rows by the chosen metric, takes the first or last N and passes that array as data. No grid feature is involved beyond rendering.

faq.question: Does it work together with column filters?
faq.answer: Yes. The column-menu filters apply on top of the sliced rows, so you can rank first and narrow by region after, or the other way round by filtering before choosing N.

faq.question: What does the KPI strip show?
faq.answer: The slice's share of the metric's total across all rows, so top 10 by revenue is reported as the percentage of revenue those ten rows account for.
